verdict.rationale: Ramp's own Banking API docs state a business can hold more than one Checking Account (WALLET_ACCOUNT), alongside investment accounts, so multiple checking accounts are evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents rules that automatically split or allocate incoming deposits across those accounts; the auto top-up and target-balance feature concerns funding Ramp from linked external checking accounts and is only adjacent. Missing for 10: documented deposit auto-allocation or split rules across checking accounts, a documented self-serve flow for opening additional sub-accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
